visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen montage featuring close-up views of steaming dim sum in bamboo baskets and a man with short dark hair in a striped shirt tasting a small pastry. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a brightly lit, busy restaurant where the man in a black T-shirt holds a white paper receipt while looking at the camera. (3) Hands wearing blue protective gloves are seen maneuvering a multi-tiered metal food trolley filled with stacked bamboo steamers in a dining room with red patterned carpets and round tables. (4) A quick exterior shot shows a large neon sign for "London Restaurant" with Chinese characters above a busy entrance. (5) In the dining area, the man demonstrates a local custom by pouring hot tea from a white pot into a small plastic bowl containing a teacup and chopsticks to rinse them. (6) Close-ups of various dishes follow: a plate of soy sauce chicken with white rice, a bowl of savory porridge, and several small dim sum plates including beef balls, shrimp dumplings, and rice noodle rolls. (7) The man is shown again, now in his striped shirt, actively eating a soup dumpling and expressing enjoyment through facial expressions. (8) The final shots return to the food cart being wheeled around by a worker in an apron and face mask, showing the variety of dishes available.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, energetic male narrator speaking in Mandarin over a high-tempo, major-key electronic pop BGM. (2) Background restaurant chatter and the clink of porcelain cups are immediately audible, creating a busy atmosphere. (3) A distinct liquid splashing sound is heard as the narrator explains the tradition of washing tea cups. (4) A metallic rattle followed by a soft thud signals the movement of a heavy dim sum cart and the placement of bamboo steamers onto a table. (5) The narrator's voice maintains a high arousal level as he describes each dish, with very short pauses between sentences. (6) A sharp pop sound effect emphasizes the appearance of an emoji on screen during a taste-test reaction. (7) Throughout the track, the balance between clear narration, steady background music, and environmental foley remains consistent.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Introduction -> Demonstration -> Climax (Eating) -> Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle and travel review intended to recommend a traditional dim sum restaurant in Mong Kok, Hong Kong. It highlights the nostalgic 'trolley service' style which is increasingly rare, educates the viewer on local dining etiquette (washing utensils with tea), and showcases popular dishes to entice travelers and food enthusiasts.
